sentences.text: No, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges on a floating rate loan granted for purposes other than business to an individual borrower when the loan was sanctioned on or after January 1, 2026.
The case facts match that scope because the loan is floating, the borrower is individual, the purpose is non_business, and the sanction date is 2026-03-01.
The documents do not state any exception that would allow a foreclosure prepayment charge on this case.

missing.searched: UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 para 261(1), 261(5), and 261(4) for floating rate loans to individuals for purposes other than business sanctioned on or after January 1, 2026
